messages:
alex_support: FYI — customer called our /v1/tokenize endpoint and ended up with a CHARGE (ch_456) created instead of just a token. Customer hit us via support and is upset. Repro steps + request body and router trace below. @jia_engineer @michelle_engineer :eyes:

jia_engineer: can you paste the raw request and the router trace/decision log? also SDK version if available

alex_support: sure — raw request (redacted):
```
POST /v1/tokenize
{
  "customer_id": "cus_123",
  "payment_method": { "number": "**** **** **** 4242", "exp_month": 12, "exp_year": 2026 },
  "intent": "tokenize"
}
Headers: { "X-Client-Version": "1.2.0" }
request_id: req_789
```

tool-router-bot: decision log for req_789:
```
selected_tool: create_charge_v2
score(create_charge_v2)=0.62
score(tokenize_payment)=0.38
reason: legacy alias 'tokenize' present in namespace 'legacy-payments' -> maps to 'tokenize_and_charge' fallback.
```

michelle_engineer: That alias still exists from old integrations. Looks like the resolver scoring picked charge. We should NOT allow create_charge for requests that explicitly set intent==\"tokenize\".

raj_infra: Proposed quick mitigation: add an explicit router guard: if path==\"/v1/tokenize\" OR body.intent==\"tokenize\" -> force tool tokenize_payment and block any charge-creating tools. I can push a config change to the routing table as a hotfix.

alex_support: repro steps from customer:
1) SDK v1.2.0 call POST /v1/tokenize with intent==\"tokenize\"
2) got 200 OK with payload { token:\"tok_abc\", charge_id:\"ch_456\" } (charge was created server-side)
3) customer sees charge on card. They did not authorize a payment.

pm_oliver: Escalating — finance needs to issue a refund asap for ch_456. Also we need a customer communication. @michelle_engineer can you give ETA on hotfix?

michelle_engineer: Hotfix plan: push router config override to canary within ~15m, run smoke tests, then full rollout (~45m). I'll also open PR to add schema validation so requests with intent==\"tokenize\" cannot route to charge tools.

raj_infra: Filed INF-2024-78 to track the infra change and add unit tests for alias resolution. Will monitor canary and rollback if errors.

alex_support: I will file the refund request and notify the customer we are on it. Adding to incident tracker and tagging affected accounts. Thanks everyone :pray:

michelle_engineer: Also note: short-term follow-up: audit other endpoints for ambiguous aliases (search for \"tokenize\" in legacy namespaces) and remove unsafe mappings.

alex_support: closing loop here — I'll update once refund confirmed.
